Rewrite the following Python 2 code into exactly 5 different variants. The code reads and writes I/O from the console. Each variant should have the exact same functionality as the given code, meaning that it should have the same output for any given input. Make the variants meaningfully different from one another and from the original code, while preserving functionality exactly.
Print all 5 rewritten variants, numbered from 1 to 5. Do not stop early, do not skip an index, and do not repeat an index. Use this exact format:

Here is the original Python 2 code you have to rewrite:
<original_code>
x=raw_input()
for i in range(1,len(x)):
    if(x[i:i+2]=='at'):
        x=x[0:i]+"@"+x[i+2:len(x)]
        break
x=x.replace('dot','.')
if(x[0:1]=='.'):
    x=x[1:len(x)]
    x='dot'+x    
if(x[len(x)-1:len(x)]=='.'):
    x=x[0:len(x)-1]
    x=x+'dot'
print(x)
